race.comment: NO IDEA (3) is a maiden galloper who hasn't raced since finishing a head back in fourth at the Sunshine Coast back in February. Fitter for three lead-up trials, including a win. Bright return anticipated. PROFITEUR'S FIL (10) is back after a break of four months. Went close to a maiden win before the layoff, finishing second at his latest appearance over 1100m at Gold Coast Poly. Looks ready to run following a minor placing in a recent Beaudesert trial. Has ability and is worth including. ANGELEO (6) raced handy on debut last start and battled on gamely into fourth at Ipswich. Sure to improve and can get off the mark this time. HEY KALUMBA (2) is a gelding by Cool Aza Beel out of Le Dejeuner who is at the races for the first time today. Scored at his latest trial. Betting to hold the key.
